name: Liaoningopterus
sum: Large anhanguerid from the Jiufotang Formation of Chaoyang, Liaoning, with the longest known pterosaur tooth.
holotype: IVPP V-13291 — Jiufotang Formation, Chaoyang, Liaoning.
material: Crushed partial skull (~61 cm) and skeleton: jaws, teeth, a cervical, wing-finger bones.
biology: Low crests on both jaw tips and huge front teeth — a fish-eater.
author: Wang and Zhou 2003

species.name: Liaoningopterus gui
species.author: Wang and Zhou 2003
species.ref: X.-L. Wang and Z.-H. Zhou. 2003. Two new pterodactyloid pterosaurs from the Early Cretaceous Jiufotang Formation of western Liaoning, China. Vertebrata PalAsiatica 41(1):34-41
